data.name: 我是首富
data.detailed_description: Welcome to "Be The Richest"! This is a hit casual simulation management game. The greater your ambition, the greater your wealth! Starting with a barbecue stall, you will gradually expand your business empire to include machinery factories, nuclear power plants, and more. Through a unique investment system, you can buy prime locations around the world and dominate the market. The game combines idle and strategic gameplay, making it incredibly entertaining. Even in your spare time, you can become a boss! Earn gold coins, upgrade your stores, and chase your dream of billions. In the game, you will experience a realistic journey of business struggle, challenge tycoons from all walks of life, unlock achievements, and win abundant rewards. Become the world's richest person and enjoy the thrill of lavish spending. Lead your business alliance to conquer all directions and seize immense wealth.
